steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...In conclusion, the strongest unit in all the Gandam series is No. 135! I'll always be a fan of the Four Heavenly Lords!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Eh? But No. 135 is only a backup of the Three Heavenly Lords! When it became famous, two of the original Three Lords had already been destroyed!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And the greatest achievement you mentioned is from the TV anime! As a manga reader, I don't think it's fair to use this to prove its strength!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Wow, you even know that?! Didn't you say you'd never watched Gandam before?!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Did you lie to me? You're in fact not Elysiland's owner, but an angel sent to make up for the regrets of my high school years!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A higher-dimensional being must have erased you—my best friend in high school in another timeline, and put you here now!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's why I meet you here! My destined BFF...?!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hehe, maybe that's true! Something must be driving you to seek happiness and joy, which is why you came here...
The blue-haired girl waves her hand behind her back surreptitiously, and the little manta ray flailing on the pile of blu-ray discs and manga e-books vanishes instantly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Now you believe me, right? Whether you want to chat with a fellow enthusiast or binge-watch anime alone, this place can grant all your wishes!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Forget those ridiculous restrictions. Who wouldn't want to snuggle cozily in the couch and just eat chocolate and watch anime all day? Enjoy yourself here and indulge in pure joy!
The girl spins around before Summer can pounce on her for a big hug, transforming into glowing particles like water droplets and vanishing in the air.
But where she disappears, a huge building rises. A dreamland specially tailored for Summer!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: An out-of-print manga library... The Sweet Treat Wonderland... A New Dis-2 studio for anime and tokusatsu films, complete with all the post-production services...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's all real! I can't even decide what to do first! But how can a hero be so easily stopped by indecision?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let me pick a random number to guide my future! Hmm, the first stop is decided, the Sweet Treat Wonderland!
Anime, manga, unlimited chocolate and ice cream, inexhaustible filming sets... All of these deeply fascinate and captivate Summer.
She even takes a moment to feel smug for having clicked the URL and not missing all of this.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ah... Feels so good! Shooting The Age of Youth Remake while enjoying an ice cream is like having a massage for the soul!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: And when I get tired, I can just lie on the beach and flip through the original edition of GoGo's Daily Adventure. Talk about living it up!
The girl lies on the beach chair and covers her face with an open manga, breathing out a sweet, satisfied sigh.
But just as the warm darkness covers her eyes, Summer catches a strange sound coming from the beach.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Wow! What was that just now?!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Huh? What?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: No, didn't you see it? Something seemed to flash by just now...

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: It looked a bit like... a big fish!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: I get it, you just haven't had enough to drink. What big fish? The big fish is with the island owner!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: I mean, hic, only the island owner can control the big fish! Come on, have another drink, and then we'll go see the big fish! No, let's go dancing!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Island... Big fish?
She gets up and walks to the edge of the beach, pinching the fine white sand.
The touch feels real. Perhaps too real... Summer notices something's slightly off.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Maybe this island... is more interesting than I thought.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But it'll be a shame if I don't enjoy every byte of it before taking it apart!
Like the other guests, the girl lets her instincts take over and chooses to continue luxuriating in this paradise. She hums an anime theme song and picks up the priceless out-of-print manga again.
